description: A combat stim that turns fear into fuel. Frontline mercs swear by it, and at it.

effects.comeon_message: It hits your blood cold. Somewhere behind your sternum, something starts winding up.
effects.onset_message: The fear goes out like a snuffed match. What is left is very calm and very willing.

overdose.message: Your body cannot tell it is dying. It sprints straight past the edge.

phases.end_message: The fire gutters out. Every wound you ignored is suddenly very loud.
phases.peak_message: Cold fire floods your veins. Pain becomes a distant rumour.

effects.take_line: You dose yourself with {name}, cold and clinical.

withdrawal.message: Everything aches. Coldfire fixes that. Coldfire fixes everything.

name: Coldfire
